compiled_state.title: As an engineer running /dso:preplanning, a copy story is auto-created for every copy-needed epic
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend the story-decomposer sub-agent invoked by /dso:preplanning so that when the target epic carries the `copy-needed` tag, it auto-drafts a dedicated copy story populated from the epic's `## Copy Needs` section.
**Why**: Without auto-creation, copy work would require manual ticket entry on every UI epic; the brainstorm tag would be a no-op.
**Scope**:
- IN: detector for `copy-needed` tag in preplanning's story-decomposer; auto-draft of one copy story referencing Copy Needs item stable_ids and gating on artifact at configured copy_dir; idempotency on re-run; no-op when tag absent
- OUT: coordination-pass task scaffolding for multi-page (separate story); gov-copy-writer agent (separate story)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, running /dso:preplanning on an epic with the `copy-needed` tag and a populated `## Copy Needs` section results in exactly one dedicated copy story attached to the epic
  ← Satisfies: sc-2 (sc-2: "preplanning auto-creates a copy story populated from Copy Needs")
- When this story is complete, the auto-created copy story description references the epic's Copy Needs item stable_ids and gates closure on a schema-conforming artifact at `<copy.artifact_dir>/<epic-id>.yaml`
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, running /dso:preplanning on an epic without the `copy-needed` tag leaves the epic without an auto-created copy story
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, re-running /dso:preplanning on the same epic does not create a duplicate copy story
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Idempotency] Detect existing copy stories by tag or by referenced epic-id stable pattern.
- [Schema coupling] If the Copy Needs schema fails to parse, surface an actionable error rather than silently skipping.
- [Correctness] The decision to attach a coordination-pass task (sc-2: distinct(page) > 1) is made by story-decomposer at preplanning time, before gov-copy-writer runs. The page count must come from the Copy Needs section, which is the only authoritative source available at preplanning time. The artifact-side page set must not be used for this decision.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
